mr_title: Avoid iterating over all clients in UserResource.getConsents()

expected_issues.title: Set modified while a lazily concatenated stream iterates it
expected_issues.description:
toConsent() removes clients from offlineClients while the lazily concatenated stream is also iterating offlineClients.stream(), which throws ConcurrentModificationException when the admin console lists a user's consents.

Stream.concat() binds the second stream's spliterator eagerly but consumes both lazily. Mapping the first stream (user consents) mutates offlineClients via remove(), and the second stream then iterates the modified HashSet, triggering a ConcurrentModificationException for users that have both a consent and an offline token for the same client. Side effects inside stream mapping must be avoided: collect consents first and filter the offline clients.

expected_issues.title: Consent listing rewritten without a test combining consent and offline token
expected_issues.description: The endpoint is rewritten to avoid scanning all clients, but no test added by this change covers a user with both an explicit consent and an offline token for the same client, the case that triggers the ConcurrentModificationException.
